name: caol.reference_camp_nearby_focused_mcw
description: Owner reference camp with one ordinary nearby bandit cabin footprint prepared as zero-credit setup; source, actors, knowledge, dispatch and physical travel remain native.

forbidden_input: direct NPC action, perception, lead, dispatch, encounter, clock, payment or return injection

steps.label: observe_reference_camp
steps.objective: Observe actual natural signal receipt, knowledge and decision through physical travel and arrival at the original owner reference camp from an ordinarily generated nearby bandit site. Continue useful gear, duty and reload observations only where real opportunities occur.
proof_targets: exact installed owner-reference copy, zero-credit nearby footprint, actual camp and original and new site identities
physical source and eligible native observer with real source and site time and geometry
same-site natural signal to knowledge or stalking, eligibility and decision, dispatch, physical travel and arrival at the original camp
actual NPC gear collection, equipment and conservation or reload when legitimately observable
invariants: the nearby bandit cabin footprint is zero-credit setup; all site registration, actors, knowledge and behavior must arise in production
archive installation, equipment or fuel placement, and avatar setup are zero-credit preparation
no direct NPC action, perception, lead, dispatch, encounter, clock, payment or return injection
a physical source or precommitted fixture does not prove knowledge, dispatch or arrival
do not infer observation from absence without an eligible observer and actual source opportunity
do not invent return deadlines or force actor outcome; retain losses and failed observations
disclose source, geometry, date, weather and continuity; distinguish signal emission, receipt and physical travel
